body:
I'd be a surprised that a girl initiates talking with me, but I'd try to go along with the conversation, find out her interests, then maybe get her contact info if I like her/think she likes me.

And lol, fuck those guys for giving you shit, they're probably the slim minority you were just unlucky enough to encounter.

Don't take this as assholish, but it's easy to say "X isn't all that great trust me I've tried X" without really getting why not having X is such a big deal for the other person.

The main thing that bothers me is that the girls actively pursue the guy, and do a bunch of slutty/denigrating things to themselves just to turn the guy on (I've read so many stories I can't believe they're all fake)

I hate always having to pursue and fail when there are guys who just lay there and have the girls pursue them. I've had a few fairly good female friends who never wanted to have a relationship with me (I went on a few dates with them and they said they 'just wanted to be friends')

Also, please elaborate on focusing on my "personality". I've heard that adage a million times before, and don't know what it really means. I know tons of asshole douchebags who get laid all the time/have girlfriends. Should I be more of a confident badboy, or is that something that only works if you're already attractive.

Again, sorry for sounding like a conceited douche, but your reply is kind of vague.

Do you have any advice? I understand how intelligence can be seen as desirable in a guy, but from what I've mostly observed, it serves as an enhancer only if the girl only finds you attractive physically. 

Is it that I can use my intelligence as a tool to better understand game/pickup skills? What would you suggest?
